title: Admin Partner Management Dashboard - Accessibility Test Plan (WCAG 2.1 AA)
overview: Comprehensive accessibility test plan for Admin Partner Management Dashboard covering WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for summary metric widgets (Pending Approvals, Active Partners, Total Products, Average Approval Time), real-time data refresh, empty states, error handling, and responsive design.

testCases.title: Dashboard page has proper heading structure
testCases.wcagCriterion: 2.4.6 Headings and Labels, 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
testCases.preconditions: Admin is logged in and on Partner Management Dashboard
steps: 2. Verify H1 exists for page title
3. Use screen reader heading navigation (H key)
4. Verify heading hierarchy is logical (no skipped levels)
expectedResults: Page has exactly one H1 heading
Heading hierarchy logical (H1 → H2 for sections)
Screen reader can navigate by headings

testCases.title: Dashboard page has proper landmarks
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard

testCases.title: Pending Vendor Approvals widget accessible
testCases.wcagCriterion: 4.1.2 Name Role Value, 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard with pending approvals
steps: 2. Verify widget has descriptive label ('Pending Vendor Approvals')
3. Verify numeric count is associated with label
4. Use screen reader to verify count announced with context
5. Verify widget has semantic structure (heading or aria-label)
expectedResults: Screen reader announces: 'Pending Vendor Approvals: X'

testCases.title: Active Partners widget accessible
testCases.wcagCriterion: 4.1.2 Name Role Value, 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard
steps: 2. Verify widget has descriptive label ('Active Partners')
3. Verify numeric count associated with label
4. Use screen reader to verify count announced with context

testCases.title: Total Products widget accessible
testCases.wcagCriterion: 4.1.2 Name Role Value, 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard
steps: 2. Verify widget has descriptive label ('Total Products')
3. Verify numeric count associated with label
4. Use screen reader to verify count announced with context

testCases.title: Average Approval Time widget accessible
testCases.wcagCriterion: 4.1.2 Name Role Value, 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard
steps: 2. Verify widget has descriptive label ('Average Approval Time')
3. Verify time value associated with label
5. Use screen reader to verify value announced with context
expectedResults: Time value programmatically associated with label
Screen reader announces: 'Average Approval Time: X days'
testCases.postconditions: Average approval time widget accessibility verified

testCases.title: Metric widgets keyboard accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard
steps: 2. If widgets are clickable, verify focus indicator visible
3. If widgets are clickable, verify Enter/Space activates
4. If widgets are non-interactive, verify they are NOT in tab order
5. Verify tab order is logical across widgets
expectedResults: Non-interactive widgets not in tab order
Focus indicators visible on interactive widgets

testCases.title: Widgets not conveyed by color alone
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard
steps: 2. Verify status/meaning conveyed by text labels
4. Test in grayscale mode — verify all widgets distinguishable
5. Verify trend indicators (if any) have text equivalents
expectedResults: Widget meaning conveyed by text, not color alone

testCases.title: Real-time data refresh announced
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard with data updating
steps: 1. Observe data refresh (real-time or on reload)
2. Verify updated values announced via aria-live region
3. Verify refresh does not disrupt user focus
4. Verify refresh does not cause page reload without warning
5. If manual refresh button exists, verify it is keyboard accessible
expectedResults: Manual refresh button accessible if present

testCases.title: Loading state accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin navigates to dashboard while data is loading
steps: 3. Verify loading state announced via aria-live or role='status'
4. Verify loading indicator has accessible name
5. Verify loading does not trap keyboard focus
expectedResults: Loading indicator visible during data fetch
Loading state announced to screen readers
Loading indicator has aria-label or text
Keyboard focus not trapped during loading

testCases.title: Empty state accessible (no vendors)
testCases.componentElement: Empty state message when no vendors available
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on dashboard with no vendors in system
steps: 1. View dashboard with no vendors available
3. Verify message provides guidance (e.g., 'No vendors registered yet')
4. Verify message announced by screen reader
5. Verify message has proper semantic structure
expectedResults: Empty state message visible and clear
Message provides guidance for next steps
Message announced via aria-live or role='status'
Message has proper heading or semantic structure

testCases.title: API error fallback message accessible
testCases.componentElement: Error message on metrics API failure
testCases.preconditions: Metrics API has failed
steps: 3. Verify message has role='alert' or aria-live='assertive'
4. Verify message announced immediately by screen reader
5. Verify retry option present and keyboard accessible
7. Verify error does not trap keyboard focus
expectedResults: Error message displayed with clear text

testCases.title: Retry button keyboard accessible
testCases.preconditions: API error is displayed with retry option
steps: 3. Verify button has accessible name ('Retry' or 'Try Again')

testCases.title: Text contrast meets WCAG AA
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard
expectedResults: All normal text has 4.5:1 contrast minimum

testCases.title: UI component contrast meets WCAG AA
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard

testCases.title: Dashboard usable at 200% zoom
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard
steps: 4. Verify no text truncation or overlap

testCases.title: Dashboard accessible on mobile viewport
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard on mobile

testCases.title: No keyboard traps on dashboard
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Partner Management Dashboard
steps: 2. Verify focus cycles through all elements
4. Verify no element traps keyboard focus
5. Verify focus can reach browser chrome

testCases.preconditions: NVDA screen reader enabled, Admin on dashboard
steps: 4. Verify all counts announced with labels
5. Trigger error state and verify announced
